output.scope_note: The paper reports room-temperature ionic conductivities of solid polymer electrolyte films (PEO-PVC)+LiPF6 with TiO2 filler, measured by impedance spectroscopy, so it is in scope.

records.evidence_quote: electrical conductivity is highest for 7 wt. % about ~5×10-5 S cm-1 at room temperature
records.notes: Highest conductivity of the series; 7 wt. % TiO2 is a filler, not a dopant, so dopants is empty. Abstract gives the same value as ~5×10 -5 S cm-1 for 7 wt. % TiO2 without a temperature. Measured with SS|SPE|SS cells, bulk resistance from Nyquist intercept.

records.material_as_written: PEO-PVC polymer blend (no salt, no TiO2)
records.evidence_quote: The ionic conductivity of polymer blend was 3.3 ×10 -8 S cm-1.
records.notes: Baseline blend without LiPF6 or TiO2. Temperature is not stated in this sentence; room temperature comes from the CIS measurement description in Section 2.3. The mobile_ion is set to other because the blend has no added salt. Quoted value is as the paper writes it.
